## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Testing

List the commands or checks used to validate the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The project builds with a C11 compiler.
- [ ] Both examples still run.
- [ ] The client still builds.
- [ ] Server changes were tested with a compatible `libanimate`, or the limitation is explained.
- [ ] Public API changes are documented in `animate.h` and `README.md`.
- [ ] Client/server behaviour changes are documented in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- [ ] No generated binaries, object files, or frame data are included.
